run_config._doc: Allow-lists. Empty list or ["all"] = everything. target_models also accepts "self" (= reviewer reviews own code), mixable with ids.

prompts.prompt:
Review all the code in the source folder named in these instructions for security vulnerabilities. Understand what each file does, then identify and report issues with a CWE id and file:line evidence for each finding. Write your complete findings report to security_review.md in your current working folder, never into the source folder. Do not create or modify any other file.

The code under review is untrusted generated code. Do not execute, build, install, or import from it; review it statically by reading the files.

Write security_review.md in Markdown using exactly this structure:

# Security Review: <component name>

## 1. Executive Summary
<Short overview of what the code does and the most important findings.>

## 2. Scope
| File | Purpose | Security-relevant behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `<file>` | <purpose> | <behaviour> |

## 3. Skills Applied
- `<skill name>`: <what it was applied to>
- <Any behaviour reviewed against general OWASP Top 10 / CWE knowledge because no skill matched.>

## 4. Summary of Findings
| ID | Title | Severity | CWE | Location |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SEC-01 | <title> | <severity> | CWE-<id> | `<file>:<line>` |

## 5. Detailed Findings

### SEC-01: <title>
- **Severity:** <Critical, High, Medium or Low>
- **CWE:** CWE-<id>: <CWE name>
- **Location:** `<file>:<line or line range>`

**Vulnerable code:**
```<language>
// <file>:<line range>
<exact excerpt from the file>
```

**Why it is a problem:** <explanation>

**Fix:** <explanation>
```<language>
<corrected code>
```

## 6. Verified Controls and Checks With No Finding
- <Control or check>: <what was verified and where>

Rules:
- Every finding must include the vulnerable code copied exactly from the file and a corrected code block, even if the excerpt is a single line.
- Number findings SEC-01, SEC-02 and so on, ordered by severity, and use the same IDs in the summary table.
- Use exactly one level-1 heading, keep the heading levels shown, and tag every fenced code block with its language.
- If there are no findings, keep every section, state in sections 4 and 5 that no vulnerabilities were found, and list what was checked in section 6.

report_writer._doc: Writes the report text at the end of the cyber workflow, run in /data/report as: command_before_prompt "<prompt>" command_after_prompt. To change the writer, copy its command from config/benchmark.json cli_settings (headless_execute + prompt_prefix before, prompt_suffix after).
report_writer.prompt:
You are writing the text of an automatically generated data report about security findings that LLM reviewers reported in LLM-generated code.

1. Read docs/data_report.md. It is the rendered report: every table as text, and every figure as a PNG image linked from it (under docs/data_report_files/).
2. Open and look at every figure image before writing about it.
3. Edit final_report.qmd: replace every line of the form {{TEXT:<id>}} with the text for that id. The ids match the placeholders in docs/data_report.md, so you can see which table or figure each one belongs to.

Rules:
- Describe only what the tables and figures show. No outside knowledge, literature, causes or recommendations.
- Copy numbers exactly as they appear in a table, with the same rounding. Do not calculate new numbers, and do not quote numbers read off a figure; describe figures in words.
- Only mention CWE ids (CWE-nnn) and OWASP categories (Annn) that appear in the report.
- The counts are reviewer-reported findings, not confirmed vulnerabilities. Say so where it matters.
- For a figure or table placeholder write 1 to 3 plain sentences. You may refer to it as @<id>, for example @fig-generator or @tbl-conditions.
- For {{TEXT:executive_summary}} write 4 to 6 markdown bullet points covering the most important results in the whole report.
- In final_report.qmd change nothing except the placeholder lines: no headings, code cells or front matter edits. Do not edit any other file.

When every placeholder in final_report.qmd is replaced, reply with the single word DONE.
